courses.title: Industry Quality Assurance and Regulatory Laboratory Practices
courses.eligibility: Students, faculty and industry professionals from biological, pharmaceutical and allied life sciences
courses.description: An Industry Readiness Program certificate course covering QA, QC, GLP, GMP, biosafety, regulatory requirements and industrial laboratory practices across the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, food and healthcare sectors. Sessions on 22 and 29 August and 5 September 2026.

courses.title: Microbiology for a Safer Food Industry: Quality, Safety and Sustainability
courses.eligibility: BS Microbiology students of 3rd and 4th year, with basic knowledge of Microbiology and Microbiological Laboratory Techniques
courses.description: An Industry Readiness Program bridging academic microbiology with the food industry: food safety, microbiological analysis, contamination control, HACCP preventive systems and quality assurance. Sessions on 2, 3 and 5 September 2026.

courses.title: Block & Screen Print Workshop
courses.description: A practical workshop in relief block printing and basic screen printing. Participants learn design transfer, inking, registration, and printing on paper and fabric.

courses.title: Canvas Painting Workshop
courses.description: A hands-on canvas painting workshop that introduces participants to colour theory, composition, and brush techniques. Suitable for beginners and hobbyists who want to build confidence in acrylic painting.

courses.title: Basic Crocheting Workshop
courses.description: Introduction to basic crochet stitches and techniques for beginners.

courses.title: Organic Soap Making Workshop
courses.description: Learn cold-process organic soap making using natural oils, butters, and essential oils. Participants will formulate, pour, and take home their own cured soap bars.

courses.title: Applied Quality Control in Zoological Sciences
courses.description: A certified short course on quality control practices in zoological and life-science laboratories, covering SOPs, documentation, instrument checks, and regulatory expectations for diagnostic and research labs.

courses.title: 3 Days Lead Implementor Training Program
courses.description: A three-day lead implementer program focused on establishing and driving management systems in organizations. Participants learn leadership of implementation teams, gap analysis, and continual improvement practices.

courses.title: SME LaunchPad Program
courses.description: Empowering women entrepreneurs through skills, knowledge, and collaboration. Build your business. Shape your future.

courses.title: Facial Serum Making Workshop
courses.description: Hands-on workshop on making facial serums with natural ingredients.

courses.title: Digital Marketing & Social Media Strategy
courses.description: Practical digital marketing skills covering social media strategy, content planning, and audience engagement.

courses.title: HRM Diploma
courses.certificate: Diploma on successful completion (80% attendance required)
courses.description: A comprehensive six-month diploma covering the full spectrum of human resource management — from recruitment and talent management to labor law and organizational development — taught by experienced HR practitioners.

courses.title: Animation & Game Design (Basic)
courses.eligibility: Matriculation or Equivalent with Basic Computer Knowledge
courses.description: A 6-month certified course designed to introduce students to the fundamentals of Animation and Game Design, with a focus on developing creative, technical, and storytelling skills. Covers 2D animation, character design, game design, storyboarding and basic game development.

courses.title: Animation & Game Design (Advance)
courses.eligibility: Matriculation & Equivalent with Basic Computer Knowledge
courses.description: A 1-year diploma program providing comprehensive training in Animation and Game Design, progressing from basic concepts to advanced techniques and industry-oriented projects. Covers 2D and 3D animation, professional game design, industry-standard tools, real-life projects and a professional portfolio.

answer.en: We offer three diplomas: Animation & Game Design (Basic) — a 6-month certified course, Animation & Game Design (Advance) — a 1-year diploma, and the HRM Diploma. Animation diplomas: Registration PKR 8,000 + PKR 10,000 per month, eligibility Matriculation with basic computer knowledge. Tap a diploma below for full details.
